purpose: Lightweight trusted-Firefox PostgreSQL persistence slice across a real owned application process restart.
conclusion: PostgreSQL data slice passed: same sessions, interaction records, and live gate survived an owned process restart. Full POC and product readiness remain unproven.

tls.trust: trusted CA imported only into isolated Firefox profiles

topology.interaction: one synthetic chat and one feedback event through the normal browser UI; chat text is never retained
topology.media: not exercised in this data persistence slice
topology.probes: two separate raw WSS normal-join probes for startup-A rejection and live-B acceptance

startupConfiguration.hostToken: provided in process memory; value not recorded
startupConfiguration.startupPassword: provided in process memory; value not recorded
startupConfiguration.livePassword: provided in process memory; value not recorded

processRuns.label: initial
processRuns.stopReason: PG-BROWSER controlled SIGTERM restart with both Firefox session pages open

processRuns.label: restarted
processRuns.stopReason: final cleanup of this script-owned child

limits.restart: the owned child receives SIGTERM, with bounded SIGKILL fallback only for that same child
limits.persistence: only this room/session/interaction/gate slice is assessed; full product readiness and complete POC-06 remain false
limits.browser: two isolated real Firefox profiles remain open and keep their original session proofs in local browser storage
limits.media: no media source, publish, subscription, codec, quality, weak-network, or endurance behavior is tested here
limits.probes: two short normal-protocol WSS joins; not a multi-browser or load test
